review_evidence: README states that the repository formalizes the statements of all seven Clay Millennium Prize Problems and the mathematics needed to express them without claiming open-problem solutions.
The hydrated source has 23 Lean files and 671 proposition declarations spanning the seven problem statements and shared supporting definitions.
The seven top-level prize statements deliberately remain sorry placeholders, which are retained formal statement prior art under the filtering policy.
summary: Retain the Lean formulations of the seven Millennium Prize Problems and their supporting mathematical interfaces.

review_evidence: Problems/*/Millennium.lean and supporting files (Variety, Quantum, HamiltonianSpectrum, Equations, RankSupport, PolynomialHierarchy, MillenniumBoundedDomain, MillenniumRDomain) each hold between 4 and 225 declaration commands.
Problems/Common/Registry.lean defines inductive ProblemStatus, inductive ResolutionShape, their label functions, and structure ClayProblem whose statement field is a Prop.
Problems/Registry.lean defines one ClayProblem value per Millennium problem, the filtered lists all_problems/open_problems/solved_problems/incomplete_problems, and theorems on their lengths.
Tests/AggregateTargets.lean defines inductive Resolution, noncomputable def resolve, and theorem or_not.

Tests/Hodge/StatementIsVacuous.lean defines CTwist with Field and IsAlgClosed instances and proves theorems including exists_ringHom_extending, isEmpty_points, isZero_bettiHomology, and clayHodge_vacuous.

Tests/NavierStokes/AggregateIsTrivial.lean defines scaling maps (scaleMap, scaleEquiv, scaledVelocity, scaledPressure) and proves about 30 theorems on partial derivatives, divergence, transport of solutions, and fefferman_disjunction.
Tests/*/Sanity.lean and Tests/Hodge/CycleClassUnconstrained.lean each hold between 6 and 17 declaration commands.
summary: Inspected all 25 changed files by counting Lean declaration commands and reading the registry, aggregate-target, and test files named as questionable. Every file holds its own formal declarations (defs, inductives, structures, instances, theorems) about the seven Millennium Prize Problem formulations or their supporting interfaces, so all stay searchable. Rules are empty.
